title: 目標達成の後に・秘密基地

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka trains diligently for the Yayoi Sho, which has been added to her schedule as preparation for the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During this time, she invites me on a hike up a mountain she often visits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The climb is steep and trying, but what awaits us at the top is a grand and vast view.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We take in the stunning scenery that Silence Suzuka so loves. Our bond grows stronger as we enjoy the view together.
